text:
prometheus-bot: ALERT: prom_scrape_failure_rate > 0.5 for job=exporter-prod (3/5 targets DOWN)
prometheus-bot: Description: multiple node_exporter targets failing scrapes in prod-east, elevated scrape errors over last 5m. See: https://prometheus.internal/alerts/INC-214365

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident INC-214365 created and paged to eng-sre on-call (alex). Escalation: eng-sre -> sre-leads -> infra. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-214365

pagerduty: Page fired: alex (oncall) - please ack the incident.

alex (oncall): ack - on it. pinging metrics-team @lina and @sam. I'll grab Prom targets and logs.

alex (oncall): running quick checks: `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=prometheus,job=collector` then `kubectl logs prometheus-collector-0 -n monitoring`

lina: I see connection reset errors to exporter-prod:9100 around 2143650000 -> connection timed out, possibly network flaps on prod-east. Also seeing missing scrape samples for kube_node_scrape_duration_seconds.

sam: adding log context — log-ingest consumer group `metrics-consumer` shows high lag on topic `node-metrics`: current lag ~210k messages, consumer lag started ~10:12 UTC. Could be backlog causing scrape processing delay. `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group metrics-consumer`

carla: on call for infra now, joining. If kafka consumers are backlogged we'll scale them. prepping `kubectl scale deployment metrics-consumer -n infra --replicas=6`

alex (oncall): doing a quick curl against exporter from prometheus collector pod: ```bash
kubectl -n monitoring exec prometheus-collector-0 -- curl -sSf http://exporter-prod-east-1:9100/metrics | head -n 20
```

lina: curl times out intermittently, 504s from exporter. Traceroute shows packet drops between prometheus-collector and exporter-prod-east-1 host. Networking flagged.

incident-bot: Incident INC-214365: severity=high, impact=dashboard-degradation. Auto-notify: paged on-call, created incident channel. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/metrics/scrape-failures

sam: scaled metrics-consumer from 2 -> 6, restarting pods to pick up new partition assignment. Monitoring lag — watching in Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/metrics/consumer-lag

carla: kicked a restart of exporter instances in prod-east: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/exporter-prod -n infra` to clear transient socket state.

alex (oncall): temporarily suppressing noisy alert rule for exporter-prom-scrape-failures to avoid cascade paging while we stabilize. Command: ```bash
curl -XPOST -s "http://alertmanager.internal/api/v1/silences" -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"PromScrapeFailure"}],"startsAt":"2026-03-14T10:30:00Z","endsAt":"2026-03-14T11:00:00Z","createdBy":"alex","comment":"temporary suppression during mitigation"}'
```

lina: after scale + restart, consumer lag drifting down to ~15k, exporter curl success rate up to ~90% from ~60%. Dashboards show missing metrics decreasing.

pagerbot: PagerDuty INC-214365 acknowledged by alex (oncall) at 2143650120. Current status: investigating -> mitigated? waiting on monitoring.

sam: logs show repeated `connection reset by peer` from exporter process right before restart, likely transient kernel networking issue on host. We should open infra ticket to replace misbehaving hosts.

carla: spun up replacement nodes for prod-east, cordoned & drained the two nodes with network errors. Replaced via autoscaler and node provisioning.

alex (oncall): handoff note: if the incident continues past 11:00Z, escalate to infra-leads and open PD high-priority. For now I'll keep monitoring for one more hour.

metrics-team: quick impact summary for SRE/Support: ~12% of customer dashboards experienced delayed or missing metrics for ~20-35 minutes during peak of the issue. No permanent data loss observed; kafka retention preserved messages. Recommend JIRA: METRICS-3244 for postmortem + infra remediation (node replacement, kernel/networking investigation).

incident-bot: Incident INC-214365 annotated: mitigation actions: scaled consumers, restarted exporters, replaced nodes. Incident severity downgraded to medium at 2143650600.

alex (oncall): marking incident as resolved in PagerDuty but keeping post-incident follow-up. `pagerduty resolve INC-214365 --notes "Mitigated: scaled consumers and restarted exporter daemonset; node replacement in prod-east."` :white_check_mark:

carla: created infra ticket INFRA-813 to triage kernel/network stack on replaced hosts.

lina: will draft postmortem and attach graphs + logs. assigning METRICS-3244 to metrics-team and ENG-OWNERS.

sam: final check — consumer lag back to normal, alerting thresholds green. closing monitoring loop. :thumbsup:

alex (oncall): thanks team. leaving a short handoff for oncoming oncall: monitoring window until 11:30Z, follow-up PRs to add extra partitioning and a fallback cache for scrapes.

metrics-team: acknowledged, will add remediation items.

carla: closing Slack thread, filing notes into incident channel and runbook updates.
